evidence.title: Storm of Silence Demo
evidence.evidence: Original Storm of Silence Demo reaches training; holding RIGHT (17) through eight scheduled timer deadlines moves the character. Identical-time idle control retains a different position.
evidence.limitations: Short single-player/input replay only. Storm is a demo; Waterski SIS is version1.00, not evidence of1.03. Full playthrough, persistence, Symbian wrapper execution and external WAV/MIDI playback are not verified. Original SGS and ROM bytes unchanged; no forced timer or game-state patches.
